pick.headline: TWA Flight 847 hijacked to Beirut
pick.fbis: The Middle East & South Asia review of June 14, 1985, reported Voice of Lebanon and Radio Free Lebanon on the hijacked U.S. airliner landing at Beirut, its hijackers demanding release of prisoners held by Israel, and 25 women and children freed.

alternates.headline: Argentine forces surrender at Port Stanley
alternates.fbis: The Latin America Daily Report of June 15, 1982, opened its Argentina section with war items: fighting around Port Stanley, a "de facto" cease-fire, a delayed Menendez-Moore meeting, and agreement on a neutral zone in Port Stanley.

alternates.headline: Basayev's fighters seize the hospital at Budennovsk
alternates.fbis: The Central Eurasia Daily Report of June 14, 1995, listed under Chechnya ITAR-TASS and Moscow Radio on gunmen seizing hostages in Budennovsk, 'terrorists' moving toward Chechnya, and a plan to blow up a factory.
